title: Romania-ready hot-food packaging candidate evidence dataset

scope.primary_flow_hypothesis: Food is cooked, transferred hot into a retail pack, held/displayed for up to approximately 6 hours, and sold.
scope.strict_interpretation: Peak oven exposure and hot-hold exposure are separate qualification conditions. A strong POST_COOK candidate is not rejected merely because it does not tolerate 250 C.

exact_selected_component_article_ids.definition: Selected candidate components with an exact article/SKU: C4 body and lid, C5 body, C6 body and selected H26 lid. Excludes alternate lids, historical grades and rejected near-misses.

alternate_exact_component_article_ids.definition: C6 alternate H46 DPET lid 5023000000; it is explicitly non-stock and is not the selected closure.

complete_systems_with_exact_component_id.definition: C4 and C6 have exact body and closure article identities; C4 is inactive and neither has a verified Romanian supply route.

current_complete_system_identity_leads.definition: C6 body plus H26 lid; Romanian orderability remains unverified.

exact_unit_component_weights.definition: C4 body and C6 body only. No selected closure has a verified unit mass.

public_price_records.definition: Three exact-component EU retailer/distributor records; all are REFERENCE_PRICE_ONLY and none is a Romanian landed/B2B price.

industrial_moq_records.note: Published pack/carton order units are not treated as negotiated industrial MOQ.

candidates.required_track: BIOPAP LC plus compatible clear film
candidates.candidate_name: BIOPAP Easy Catering SI-14 plus compostable clear sealing film

identity.configuration: 1240 ml BIOPAP LC-technology tray plus manufacturer-compatible transparent compostable sealing film
identity.statement: SI-14 body identity is exact. BIOPAP supports a compatible transparent compostable film as a system component, but no exact film SKU, gauge, reel specification or mass was public.

application_modes.boundary: Exact SI-14 is sold for catering/ready meals and top sealing; filled-pack sponsor validation remains required.
BIOPAP LC family/system states 6 h at 90 C or 5 h at 100 C. Public evidence does not explicitly bind SI-14 plus a named film SKU to that claim.
BIOPAP LC family states conventional oven to 185 C for 60 min. Exact SI-14 plus unnamed clear film is not separately qualified as a closed cook-in pack.
LC family thermal evidence is relevant; exact SI-14 technical sheet is still required.
Transparent compostable sealing film is a supported system component, but exact film identity and hot-application profile are absent.
